{{Attr|Nimble}} (Variable) }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|After logging these new ducks into our system, there's a...chunky duck?|audio = BathroomApproachWave 17 1.ogg|[[Dispatcher]] dialogue on Wave 17 (Formerly, [[Bathroom Approach]])}} }} ==Description== The '''Chunky Ducky''' was a tanky enemy that appeared in [[Bathroom Approach]] as part of the [[Ducky Revenge Event]]. As a large enemy, it has high health and below average speed. It also has 50% defense, reducing most forms of damage by 33%. ==Logbook Description== "''Chunky Ducky aspires to be as wide and double-thick as Fat Ducky. However, the Evil Duckies would often be found knocking Chunky Ducky over and rolling him across the room. When Chunky Ducky lies down, it's not uncommon for a duckling or two to go missing beneath him. He means well, but is simply misunderstood.''" ==Appearance== The '''Chunky Ducky''' is a massively wide yellow duck with black eyes, an orange beak and flippers. It is significantly larger than most other duckies and it has an extremely wide body. It has three animations that it can randomly have, where all three also have differently shaped eyes. The first animation has it have a happy expression, the second has it have a serious expression while the third one has its eyes partially closed, likely because it is scared. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Bathroom Approach]] is listed instead. *The [[Minigunner]], [[Ranger]] and [[Pursuit]] can easily deal with the '''Chunky Ducky'''. **As this enemy has high health with defense, you could use slowing towers such as the [[Tesla]] or [[Electroshocker]] to slow them down and decrease their defense. ***Do note that the '''Chunky Ducky''' has [[Freeze Immunity]], so towers like the [[Freezer]] are unable to affect it. *AOE towers like the [[Mortar]], [[Rocketeer]] or bottom path [[Pursuit]] can be used to deal damage to the '''Chunky Ducky''' and the hordes of enemies it generally spawns with. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} ChunkyDuckDeath.gif|Current death animation (16 April 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants}} DefHacker1ChunkyDucky1.png|Green variant, current version, first animation variant (11 June 2025 – Present) DefHacker1ChunkyDucky2.png|Green variant, current version, second animation variant (11 June 2025 – Present) DefHacker1ChunkyDucky3.png|Green variant, current version, third animation variant (11 June 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseChunkyDucky.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (16 April 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} Ducky Battlepass -
